key_insight: A 1/L residual scaling rule supports learning-rate transfer across depth for constrained spectral optimizers while preserving feature learning.
engineering_relevance: For Scion, the derived scaling rules support reusing learning rates across model depth and width, potentially reducing hyperparameter tuning.
method: Analyze Frank–Wolfe and projected non-Euclidean normalized steepest descent with linear minimization oracles.
Derive depth-scaling rules that recover 1/L residual scaling through arguments distinct from Adam-family analyses.
Establish conditions supporting feature learning rather than kernel-regime behavior.
evidence_signal: Experiments report depth-wise learning-rate transfer and feature learning in nanoGPT on FineWeb, DeiT on ImageNet, and MLP-Mixer on CIFAR-10 with appropriate residual scaling.
watch_item: Transfer depends on appropriate residual scaling; the abstract does not quantify tuning savings or establish universality across architectures.
paper_title: Learning Rate Transfer and Feature Learning Across Depth for Constrained Spectral Optimizers: Complete Scion
